criteria.quote: Raichu’s strangest response begins when its pouches run empty.
criteria.revision: Replace it with: “Raichu’s tail doesn’t just discharge electricity—it also gathers it when its electric pouches run empty.” This makes the unusual contrast immediate using only the documented tail functions.

criteria.quote: Its Pokédex entry links empty pouches to one surprising response.
criteria.revision: Replace the generic line with: “When its electric pouches run empty, Raichu raises its tail to gather electricity from the atmosphere.” Name the exact behavior instead of referring vaguely to a Pokédex clue.

criteria.quote: Why would empty electric pouches make Raichu raise its tail?
criteria.revision: Sharpen the open loop to: “Why does an empty charge make Raichu raise its tail instead of discharging it?” The contrast is grounded in the entries describing discharge when overcharged and atmospheric gathering when empty.

criteria.quote: When overcharged, its tail discharges. When empty, it gathers electricity.
criteria.revision: Make the overcharged state add stakes before revealing the reversal: “When its electrical sacks are excessively charged, Raichu plants its tail in the ground and discharges—scorched patches can be found near its nest. But when the pouches run empty, that tail rises to gather electricity from the atmosphere.”

criteria.quote: With its tail raised, Raichu gathers electricity from the atmosphere.
criteria.revision: Delay this reveal until after the discharge behavior. Let an earlier scene establish the tail as an outlet, then use this exact atmospheric-gathering fact as the reversal. The current title and premise reveal the surprise before the scenes do.

criteria.quote: THE TAIL HANDLES BOTH EXTREMES / ONE TAIL. TWO ELECTRIC JOBS.
criteria.revision: Remove or replace one of these overlapping scenes. A distinct replacement could be: “Raichu’s electricity can reach 100,000 volts—careless contact can make even an Indian elephant faint.” This adds a concrete power detail rather than restating the tail’s two functions.

criteria.quote: Raichu’s tail can discharge excess power or gather electricity from the atmosphere when its pouches run empty.
criteria.revision: Strengthen the ending by synthesizing the contrast: “The same tail that discharges Raichu’s excess electricity into the ground is raised to gather electricity from the atmosphere when its pouches run empty.” This resolves the opening question with the tail’s documented two-way function.

criteria.quote: Clever way to gather electricity, or strange tail trick?
criteria.revision: Replace it with: “Is Raichu’s tail better understood as an electrical outlet, an electrical collector, or both?” This creates a genuine interpretation split while staying anchored to its documented discharge and atmospheric-gathering behaviors.
